## Tester Profile

- **Testing Context**: _(e.g., Agency, In-House SEO, Open-Source Contributor, Independent Developer)_
- **Deployment Mode**: _(e.g., `npx open-semrush`, Docker Compose, Self-hosted Node)_
- **Platform / Architecture**: _(e.g., Ubuntu 24.04 x64, macOS M2, Windows 11 x64)_

## Crawl & Audit Experience

- **Site Type Tested**: _(e.g., E-commerce, SPA / React, News/Blog, Static HTML, Multi-lingual)_
- **Scale Tested**: _(e.g., Single page, 10-50 pages, 500+ pages)_
- **Estimated Audit Time / Responsiveness**: _(e.g., Fast (<1s/page), Average, Slow)_

## Findings & Evaluation

- **Accuracy Feedback**: _(Did the audit identify real issues? Were there false positives or false negatives?)_
- **Feature Usability**: _(What felt smooth? What was confusing or missing?)_
- **AI Recommendation Quality**: _(If AI recommendations were enabled, how relevant and actionable were they?)_

## Suggested Enhancements or Issues Encountered

Provide any constructive suggestions, edge cases, or logs (ensure all private URLs/tokens are redacted).
